title: Cart
description: Mutable basket owned by checkout. Never leaves the component.

customer-id.description: Account or guest-session reference; pseudonymous after erasure.

currency.description: Fixed at creation. One currency per cart, per ADR 0001.

lines.description: Lines as the customer has built them so far.

subtotal.description: Sum of the line totals, before tax and shipping.

expires-at.description: After this instant checkout refuses to convert the cart.
